import ctypes, errno, os, sys
class Filter(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_=[('code',ctypes.c_ushort),('jt',ctypes.c_ubyte),('jf',ctypes.c_ubyte),('k',ctypes.c_uint)]
class Program(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_=[('length',ctypes.c_ushort),('filters',ctypes.POINTER(Filter))]
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
    instructions=[(0x20,0,0,4),(0x15,1,0,0xc000003e),(0x06,0,0,0x80000000),(0x20,0,0,0),(0x35,0,1,0x40000000),(0x06,0,0,0x80000000),(0x15,0,1,435),(0x06,0,0,0x50000|errno.ENOSYS),(0x15,0,1,56),(0x06,0,0,0x50000|errno.EPERM),(0x06,0,0,0x7fff0000)]
    array=(Filter*len(instructions))(*(Filter(*r) for r in instructions))
    prog=Program(len(instructions),array)
    libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
    r1=libc.prctl(4,0,0,0,0); r2=libc.prctl(38,1,0,0,0); r3=libc.prctl(22,2,ctypes.byref(prog),0,0)
    sys.stderr.write('seccomp %s %s %s errno=%s\n'%(r1,r2,r3,ctypes.get_errno()))
    try:
        os.fork(); sys.stderr.write('fork allowed!\n')
    except OSError as e:
        sys.stderr.write('fork denied %s\n'%e)
    os._exit(0)
os.waitpid(pid,0)
